title: Canonical Digamma Polynomials and the Fifth Harmonic Bridge
scope: Research continuation with analytic proofs and finite exact replays; no worldwide priority, proof-assistant verification, or arithmetic independence claim.

claims.label: prop:mellin
claims.statement: Completed Mellin representation and reciprocal-Gamma principal Laurent coefficients at every height-one depth.

claims.label: thm:Cpoles
claims.statement: Exact strict-harmonic residues, first actual pole, and all removable negative-integer values of the meromorphic Gamma coefficient family.
claims.qualification: The Gamma generator and its harmonic integer values are established objects; this is their functional residue organization.

claims.label: thm:Cintegral
claims.statement: Ordinary integral of C_m equals m! times c_m minus the literal depth-(m-1) linear Laurent coefficient, for every m>=2.
claims.qualification: Degree two is Coffey's known formula; the Cauchy series for the coefficient is known from Young.

claims.label: thm:scalar-gamma-normalization
claims.statement: Unique monic scalar residue normalizer up to additive constant, with explicit finite defects decaying at infinity.
claims.source_target: Quartic report Question 2, residue-level partial resolution.

claims.label: cor:Aintegrals
claims.statement: All-degree finite-part formula for inverse-Gamma differential polynomials, including the sinc correction and every endpoint constant.

claims.label: q5:main
claims.statement: Complete fifth digamma-power finite part and the mixed integral I in literal strict-Laurent and holomorphic double-zeta derivative coordinates.

claims.label: q5:constants
claims.statement: Exact finite harmonic sum identities fixing all asymptotic and nonlogarithmic constants in the fifth-power calculation.
Normalized primitives, derivative Euler sums, polylogarithmic kernels and exact Taylor radius.

claims.label: tr:main
claims.statement: All centered two-even-tail moments reconstructed from D_0 through D_N, N=q(q-p)/2+q/2+p-1 for p<q; formal coordinate rank q.
claims.qualification: No arithmetic independence of the actual coordinates is asserted.

claims.statement: For equal orders p=q the first q moments suffice; complete determinant is (-1)^(b(b-1)/2)/(b! (2q-1)!!), b=q/2.
Explicit (2,6) inverse and absolutely convergent polygamma sum with value -7808/3.

claims.label: eq:audit-young-sign-translation
claims.statement: Young2024's conventional first Stieltjes constant is the negative of the literal linear Laurent coefficient; correct the verbal identification and retain formulas with their conventional sign.
claims.qualification: This is a wording/convention correction in the external paper, not an established new error in the inspected current repository.

claims.label: conj:firstq
claims.statement: The first q moments suffice for every unequal even pair.
claims.evidence: Exact finite checks through q=24, not an all-pairs proof.

claims.statement: A scalar polynomial can remove all unwanted lower-depth arithmetic coordinates at every degree.
Reduction or arithmetic independence of the additional mixed combination J'(1).
The manuscript S6 and revised S8 ladder candidates.
